text:
jess: CI is red on main, publish stage failing at docker push step. Not sure if this is a Dockerfile change or registry flake. Can someone quick-look?

ci-bot: Build #5023 failed during image push. Registry returned 504 on chunk upload.

jess: snippet from task log:
```
Pushing layer 7/12: sha256:abcd...
PUT https://registry.prod.redwood.io/v2/repo/blobs/uploads/ -> 504 Gateway Timeout
docker: error during push: unexpected EOF
```

leo: @jess fyi we've seen S3-backed registry 504s when upload multipart commits time out. Could be transient S3 latency. Any recent Dockerfile that added a huge layer?

sam: I changed a chown+tar layer in #5211 last night, but CI on that PR passed. worth bisect if reruns keep failing.

anika: quick triage checklist:
- try rerun (occasionally ephemeral)
- if reproducible, try `docker build --no-cache` + push to see if cached blob upload is the failure trigger
- collect raw registry logs and s3 request IDs

jess: re-triggering CI with no-cache now (ci rerun requested). tagging @eng-infra for visibility. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ci-bot: Rerun requested by jess for build #5024.

ops-bot: Observability: S3 eu-west-1 reported elevated 5xx rate between 10:03-10:09 UTC (alerts: S3-5xx-spike-123). Correlating with registry errors.

leo: if rerun fails, try lowering concurrent uploads in the push client, e.g. `REGISTRY_UPLOAD_CONCURRENCY=1` or `docker push --max-concurrent-uploads=1` (if supported). Also try a direct PUT replication to S3 to reproduce.

sam: noting the bisect plan: if rerun fails twice, I can `git bisect` across last 5 commits touching Dockerfile and run `docker build && push` locally until we isolate.

jess: rerun completed: build #5024 succeeded after automatic retry (registry client retried the final commit). Logs show two 504s then success. Marking as likely transient S3 spike.

anika: action items:
- sam: open a tiny task to add exponential backoff + 3 retries for registry upload in CI (reduce flakes)
- eng-infra: add a dashboard panel showing registry push 5xx rate correlated with S3 5xxs
- if this resurfaces, run `curl -v` reproduction script and attach request IDs from registry logs to the S3 team

sam: will open issue and assign to infra next week. :memo:

jess: thanks all. closing for now, re-open if it reappears. :white_check_mark:
